messages:
Nora Patel: FYI - HardwareMarket + SI Fusion are greenlit for a joint marketplace launch July 21. Need a compact SI co-sell + gainshare handoff doc before we announce. Key asks: inbound lead ownership window, revenue split gating (gainshare), account mapping, demo-credit flow, & announcement cadence.

Kenji Sato: Proposal: SI Fusion owns inbound marketplace leads for 10 calendar days to allow for hardware procurement talks. Attribution/gainshare: SI gets 70/30 credit (SI/Redwood) if deal closes within 120 days of SI claim and SI completed a POC checklist. Otherwise 40/60.

Marisol Vega: 120 days seems long but hardware cycles are slow; ok. We need explicit POC artifacts logged (POC checklist URL, signed test plan). Without artifacts default to 40/60. Also require partner to accept gainshare terms during marketplace onboarding.

Theo Grant: CRM mapping proposal: lead_source=marketplace_hardwaremarket, si_partner_id, si_claimed_ts, poc_evidence_url, gainshare_tier, auto_reassign_at, audit_notes. Also add demo_credits_allocated and demo_credits_used.

Comms Bot: Draft playbook link created: https://confluence.redwood.ai/partners/hardwaremarket-si-fusion-gainshare (draft) :link: 

Nora Patel: For routing: when lead created -> set auto_reassign_at = created_at + 10d. If SI claims -> set si_claimed_ts and set si_attribution_expires = now + 120d. POC checklist must be uploaded within 14 days of claim to qualify for 70/30.

Kenji Sato: SI Fusion will emit procurement status updates via webhook (order_intent, lead_time_days). We'll post sample payload. We want a field 'hardware_priority' so Redwood SDRs can triage.

Marisol Vega: On demo-credit policy: 5 hardware-demo credits per lead. If SI claims they receive credits; unused credits return to Redwood on reassign. Keep CSV reconciliation for finance.

Theo Grant: Automation pseudocode for SFDC in playbook:
```
on create:
  set lead_source = "marketplace_hardwaremarket"
  set auto_reassign_at = created_at + 10d
on partner claim:
  set si_claimed_ts = now
  set si_attribution_expires = now + 120d
  require poc_evidence_url within 14d else set gainshare_tier = "40/60"
on webhook procurement event:
  set hardware_priority = payload.order_intent
```

Nora Patel: Who owns implementation? Kenji can own partner webhook + procurement feed. Theo will own SFDC flows. Marisol owns playbook + gainshare legal language.

Kenji Sato: I'll post webhook spec today and create a Jira for partner-side integration.

Marisol Vega: I'll draft the gainshare terms and opt-in text. Legal to review. Also marketing needs a joint announcement timeline + co-branded asset pack. Who owns the 1-pager?

Theo Grant: I'll draft a technical 1-pager (integration notes + lead flow) and Marketing can handle the customer-facing single-sheet. ETA Wed for draft.

Comms Bot: Jira created PART-13009 hardwaremarket-si-fusion-routing (assignee: Kenji Sato) - https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/PART-13009

Nora Patel: Timeline: playbook + SFDC mapping by EOD Fri, webhook sample by Kenji by tomorrow, gainshare legal text by Marisol by Thu. Marketing to confirm announcement slot after legal sign-off. Any blockers?

Kenji Sato: No blockers. Posting payload sample shortly.

Marisol Vega: Looping Legal now. Will flag any privacy/consent text needed on listing.

Theo Grant: I'll start SFDC flow ticket and add the field list to Confluence.

Nora Patel: Thanks team. Once Confluence has the POC checklist and webhook contract we'll invite SI Fusion for final sign-off and lock the announcement date. :rocket:
